head: da11e35
purpose: Exercise build-sbf.sh's mid-build provenance rejection, which the real builds could only show on the equal path.
method: MC_SBF_BUILDER pointed at a fake builder (sha256 below) that reports the pinned version string, copies the pinned ELF into MC_SBF_OUTPUT_DIR (a scratch dir, not the artifacts dir) and appends a comment to solana/crates/economics/src/backers.rs before exiting; the wrapper then recomputes the digest.
mutated_input: solana/crates/economics/src/backers.rs (restored from a saved copy, verified sha256 107f9a27e729283892eb… = pre-test)

observed.stderr: source set changed during build (before=613eb0c5d7bbda62eaf22ad4d0ff5ff299f15f86e2794f9551a6903a3c8e786f after=e466fbdb9ccfb1b5eca04cb91bcf41ffee84e017cf8f22c59342e6c4299d68f1); provenance rejected
observed.git_status_after: clean except the untracked Codex supervision note

assertions: no receipt line is printed on a digest mismatch
the fresh artifact is moved aside, not left in place under the canonical name
a change to the economics path dependency alone is detected (the economics crate is in the set)
exit code 3 distinguishes provenance rejection from preflight (2) and build/artifact failures (1)
proof_level: local negative test of the wrapper guard with a fake builder; not a build of new bytes; the real toolchain path is covered by 2026-10-14-m0-stub-build.json
